operation.slotSetup: Use an end mill rated for the entry. For an open end, enter the stock edge and leave room for tool travel beyond it.

check.jobToolChangeHeight: Set Safe Z for Go to above every operation’s clearance before saving a job with tool changes.
check.invalidJob: The job could not be assembled.
check.jobTooLarge: The program exceeds the 512 KiB save limit.
check.count: {label} must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
check.chooseTool: Choose a tool from the tool table.
check.stepover: Stepover must be more than 0 % and at most 100 % of the tool diameter.
check.centre: Enter the centre X and Y.
check.toolTooBigPocket: The tool (diameter {diameter}) is too big for this pocket.
check.toolTooBigBore: The tool (diameter {diameter}) is too big for this bore.
check.boreTooBig: The bore is more than twice the tool diameter: a core would stay in the middle. Use a circular pocket.
check.finishAllowance: The finish allowance must be less than half the difference of bore and tool diameter.
check.cornerRadiusRange: The corner radius must be from zero to half the smaller side.
check.cornerRadiusSmall: The corner radius is smaller than the tool radius ({radius}). Enter 0 or at least the tool radius.
check.columnSpacing: Column spacing must not be zero.
check.rowSpacing: Row spacing must not be zero.
check.retractAboveClearance: The retract height must not be above the clearance height.
check.slotToolWidth: The width must be at least the tool diameter ({diameter}).
check.slotTravel: The slot must be longer than it is wide and leave room for the tool to travel.
check.slotAngle: The ramp angle must be greater than 0° and less than 90°.
check.slotPrecision: Increase the feeds, depth, clearance or depth per pass to fit the program’s precision.
check.slotRampRoom: The slot is too short for this ramp angle. Increase the angle or choose Plunge.
check.slotMoveCount: The slot would produce too many moves. Increase the depth per pass or ramp angle.
check.noHole: There is no hole to drill.
